summary:
JPMAM dominates this window (18 of 26 items) with a valuation/concentration dashboard: S&P 500 P/E near the statistical average, the top-10 stocks at 39% of market cap ($26T), and the index framed as "majority AI" (50.8%).

Cembalest/JPMAM also flags hyperscaler debt issuance pressuring the long end of the yield curve, and unrealized Anthropic/OpenAI valuation gains inflating S&P 500 "other income."

Deutsche Bank (3) covers AI-debt issuance by hyperscalers, China closing the AI capability gap, and a September geopolitical risk calendar.

Apollo's Torsten Slok (2) ties Fed-hike-era multiple compression to a hot jobs/ISM prices-paid print and floats a September rate hike ahead of CPI.

Morgan Stanley (1) sizes hyperscaler off-balance-sheet AI commitments at $3.1T+; Goldman (1) and BofA (1) each contribute one conference-preview / framework item.

No Neil Sethi (@neilksethi / @neilksethinew) items appeared in this window, and no duplicate charts or text were found to collapse — all 26 kept items are unique, single-instance charts, entirely relayed by MikeZaccardi.

**By bank:** JPM 18, Deutsche 3, Apollo/Slok 2, Morgan Stanley 1, Goldman 1, BofA 1.
